An unique value for port interface reported. It can be ETH-x, COLAN or HSL-x ports, specified using ifIndex. All administratively enabled ports are reported, regardless their operational status. Not-enabled admisnitratively ports are skipped. IfIndex is always reported in acsending order but may be not consequent.

Parameter shows Kbps of traffic egresses from Port (TX direction). Calculated as average BW in last 30 sec (using 6 samples with 5sec averaged each). If port is operationally down (and data is unavailable) -1 is reported.

Parameter shows Kbps of traffic intgressing to Port (RX direction). Calculated as average BW in last 30 sec (using 6 samples with 5sec averaged each). If port is operationally down (and data is unavailable) -1 is reported.
Parameter shows in Kbps Egress Rate Limit specified on Port (limiting ifSpeed in Transmission direction). Special value of 0 means NO LIMIT (port may perfirm in TX on IfSpeed).
Parameter shows in Kbps Ingress Rate Limit specified on Port (limiting ifSpeed in Receieve direction). Special value of 0 means NO LIMIT (port may perform in RX on IfSpeed).

Parameter shows % of port utilization, calculated as PortEgressBW divided to min (ifSpeed or portEgressRateLimit applied). Reported in units of 1 = 0.001% , i.e. 5985 means 5.985% of port throughput capability is utilized.

Parameter shows % of port utilization, calculated as PortIngressBW divided to min (ifSpeed or portIngressRateLimit applied). Reported in units of 1 = 0.001%, i.e. 5985 means 5.985% of port throughput capability is utilized.
Index of EVC. Used for Table running. Not accessible leaf (do not return any value on get).

This index uniquely (per NE) identifies MEF10 resource used on ML NE for Ethernet Virtual Connection control. On ML products EVC is a logical name only, the rest of functionality is bonded with SERV-AID. Basic ML600 supports 0 EVC (SERV). ML640, ML650 models support up to 8 EVC/SERV-{1-8}. ML640E models support up to 32 EVC/SERV-{1-32}. SDU-400 supports 2048 EVC/SERV-{1-2048}.

CIR (green) and EIR (yellow) traffic passed to EVC/SERV egress (TX direction). Measured and reported in Kbps units. Calculated as average BW in last 30 sec (using 6 samples with 5sec averaged each). Unsupported on ML640E (reported as 0).

CIR (green) and EIR (yellow) traffic not passed to EVC egress (TX direction). It was dropped due to overbooking of services on the port or due to reduction of available BW on the HSL port. Measured in Kbps. Calculated as average BW in last 30 sec (using 6 samples with 5sec averaged each). Unsupported on ML640E (reported as 0).

Red traffic (above CIR+EIR) dropped. It was intentionally discarded by EVC meter/policer as arrived more then allowed by CIR+EIR for this EVC. Measured in Kbps. Calculated as average BW in last 30 sec (using 6 samples with 5sec averaged each).
CIR (green) traffic arrived , average BW. Measured in Kbps. Calculated as average BW in last 30 sec (using 6 samples with 5sec averaged each). Counter available on ML640E models only
CIR (green) traffic transmitted , average BW. Measured in Kbps. Calculated as average BW in last 30 sec (using 6 samples with 5sec averaged each). Counter available on ML640E models only
EIR (yellow) traffic arrived , average BW. Measured in Kbps. Calculated as average BW in last 30 sec (using 6 samples with 5sec averaged each). Counter available on ML640E models only
EIR (yellow) traffic transmitted , average BW. Measured in Kbps. Calculated as average BW in last 30 sec (using 6 samples with 5sec averaged each). Counter available on ML640E models only

IP Source Address specified as a filter for a loopback, reported as a string in dot numeric for IPv4 or hexa-column for IPv6 explicit values or as ANY value if IP DA is not a part of filter (don't care). Supported by ML640E models only, for the rest - always return string ANY.

IP Destination Address specified as a filter for a loopback, reported as a string in dot numeric for IPv4 or hexa-column for IPv6 explicit values or as ANY value if IP DA is not a part of filter (don't care). Supported by ML640E models only, for the rest - always return string ANY.

L4 Port Source Address specified as a filter for a loopback, Valid values 0-65535, where 65535 means - ANY value, i.e. L4 SA Port is not a part of filter (don't care). Supported by ML640E models only, for the rest - always return 65535 .

L4 Port Destination Address specified as a filter for a loopback, Valid values 0-65535, where 65535 means - ANY value, i.e. L4 DA Port is not a part of filter (don't care). Supported by ML640E models only, for the rest - always return 65535 .

IP Version, used to identify L4 header offset, applicable in case when L3 filters (IPSA/IPDA) are unspecified, while L4 filters (at least one of PORTSA,PORTDA) is specific. Valid values - 4, 6, ANY. Fully supported by ML640E models only, for the rest - always return ANY.
